issues.issue: False-positive flags for p-values 0.0114 and 0.0007: both appear in the citation quote 'p-value0.01140.0007' (concatenated), so they are supported.
False-positive flags for '125', '2', and '4': these are the dose (125 mcg) and dosing schedule (every 2/every 4 weeks), not efficacy numbers.
False-positive flags for '125', '2', and '4': these describe the dose and dosing interval, not patient counts; the Ns (500/500/512/1512) are in the citation.
False-positive flag for '1': the '(Study 1)' label is an internal card alias, not an efficacy/safety number.
False-positive flags for '16' and '2013': these are part of the receipt date (May 16, 2013), which is excluded from scope, and the quote does not need to contain it.
Minor: the '505(o)' statutory authority added in the text is not in the citation quote, but this is a statutory reference rather than an efficacy/safety number.
